Contact us

Questions, ideas, community issues or media enquiries. Send us a message and the constituency office will respond.

Send us a message

Use the form and the constituency office will get back to you. Office phone and WhatsApp details will be listed here.

Common questions

How do I find my branch executives?

Use the branch finder on the home page to find your electoral area, then send us a message. We will put you in touch with the executives for your polling station.

I am a KNUST student. Can I join here?

Yes. Students can join TEIN-KNUST, the party’s student wing on campus, and take part in the constituency’s work. Tick "Youth Wing or TEIN" on the sign-up form.

How do I become a polling station agent?

Sign up on the Get involved page and tick "Polling station agent". Agents are trained before every election, and training dates are posted on the Events page.

Can the party help with a problem in my community?

Tell us about it using the form on this page and choose "Raise a community issue". We will pass it on to the right people, including the Municipal Assembly where appropriate.
